text:
Nora Q: kicking off follow-ups for the 02:10 UTC intermittent retries. Pattern looks like TTL oscillation + route cache not expiring cleanly after cert swap. opening thread to capture owners.
Sam D: timeline? which regions and routesets?
Nora Q: spike 02:08-02:18 UTC. majority na-south1 -> eu-west2. RouteCache-E showed IP churn; some resolvers returned the pre-roll IP while others returned post-roll for ~6m.
Victor H: quick triage: TTLs were lowered for the cert rotation but our LB cache invalidation didn't run in the rollout window due to a race with the deploy lock. result: certs bound to new ips while some edges kept old IPs -> TLS handshake errors and retries.
Sam D: immediate items I propose: 1) emergency cache flush command + runbook snippet, 2) add predeploy DNS/resolver parity check, 3) telemetry for "dns.ttl_oscillation" and "tls.bind_mismatch", 4) create recurring review ticket for routing/DNS drift.
Nora Q: I'll take #1. Adding flush command to runbooks and a verification step. ETA: 3h. flush example: `./tools/flush-route-cache --set routecache-e --force`
Victor H: I'll take #2 and #3. Plan: small CI smoke that queries authoritative NS and regional resolvers and errors if answers diverge >30s. Telemetry: increment `dns.ttl_oscillation` when we detect mixed answers in 1m windows. ETA PR: EOD.
Nora Q: @infra-bot please schedule a canary in eu-west2 after flush and CI parity land.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: ttl-osc-check-2026-04-12-03:30 (eu-west2). Results will be posted to this thread.
SRE Oncall: quick checks for manual validation:
```
# verify answers from authoritative + regional resolver
dig +short api.routecache-e.redwood.internal A @ns1.authoritative
for r in ns1.eu-west2 ns2.eu-west2; do dig +short api.routecache-e.redwood.internal A @$r || true; done
# test SNI cert on both ips
curl -v --resolve api.routecache-e.redwood.internal:443:198.51.100.55 https://api.routecache-e.redwood.internal/health
curl -v --resolve api.routecache-e.redwood.internal:443:203.0.113.66 https://api.routecache-e.redwood.internal/health
```
Sam D: created NET-520: "routecache ttl oscillation & cert-rollout cache guards" assigned to Networking. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-520
Victor H: PoC parity check details: query authoritative SOA serial and compare A sets across regionals; emit metric if soa_diff > 0 or set_diff not empty. Will push branch net/ttl-parity.
Nora Q: Owners recap:
- Nora Q: emergency flush + runbook update 3h
- Victor H: predeploy parity CI + telemetry `dns.ttl_oscillation` EOD for PR
- Sam D: create NET-520 + recurring 6-week review cadence h (ticket created)
- SRE Oncall: monitor canary and new metrics for 72h after deploy
SRE Oncall: Canary early: 5/5 health checks passing over 20m, no TLS handshake errors. Will watch `dns.ttl_oscillation` for 48h.
Nora Q: thanks team. We'll reconvene here in 48h to either close or add follow-ups. Keeping this thread as the tracker. :white_check_mark:
